title: The Monkey's Paw by W. W. Jacobs | A Quiet, Chilling Tale for the Night
hook: A wet winter night. A warm fire. A visitor with a strange little souvenir from India, and a warning he begs them to heed. Settle in, and listen to a tale about what we wish for.
description: W. W. Jacobs' classic 1902 tale of a quiet English family and a withered talisman said to grant three wishes. Narrated slowly for a candlelit evening, it is a masterpiece of gothic suspense and dread.

trailers.title: The Soldier Throws the Paw on the Fire
trailers.script: A cold, wet night in Laburnam Villa. Sergeant-Major Morris has told the White family of a monkey's paw, dried like a mummy, enchanted by an old fakir so that three men could each have three wishes. He admits he has had his three, and that the first owner's last wish was for death. Then, without warning, he dangles the paw between finger and thumb and flings it onto the fire. Mr. White snatches it out of the flames. The soldier warns him gravely: if you keep it, don't blame me for what happens. Hold it up in your right hand and wish aloud, he says, but I warn you of the consequences. Mr. White slips it into his pocket. Follow for the full story.
trailers.description: A soldier tosses a cursed paw into the fire, and his host pulls it out.

trailers.title: It Twisted in His Hand Like a Snake
trailers.script: Mr. White does not know what to wish for. It seems he already has all he wants. His son Herbert suggests two hundred pounds, enough to clear the house. Smiling shamefacedly at his own credulity, the old man holds up the paw. Herbert sits at the piano and strikes a few impressive chords. I wish for two hundred pounds, says Mr. White, distinctly. A crash from the piano greets the words, and then a shuddering cry. It moved, he says. As I wished, it twisted in my hand like a snake. There is no money to be seen. Outside, the wind rises, and upstairs a door bangs. Follow for the full story.
trailers.description: The first wish is spoken, and the paw seems to move in the old man's hand.

trailers.title: The Knocking at the Door
trailers.script: The candle gutters and dies. The paw lies still. Relieved, he creeps back to bed. Then, in the silence, a knock sounds on the front door, so quiet and stealthy it is scarcely audible. He freezes. It comes again. A third knock. His wife wakes. It's Herbert! she screams. She runs for the door, but he catches her arm. For God's sake, don't let it in, he cries. The knocks grow louder, a perfect fusillade, and she is drawing back the bolt while he gropes on the floor for the paw. Follow for the full story.
keywords: old wooden door knocking at night
trailers.description: Knocking begins at the door of a grieving house in the dead of night.
